It was great to join the @USChamber this morning during their Committee of 100.

I discussed my strong support for local Main Streets across America and encouraged businesses to help empower parents by utilizing the updated child care tax credits I secured in the Working Families Tax Cuts Act.

Republicans delivered the largest tax cut in history for hardworking Americans, and every single Democrat voted against it, including historic child care relief for families.

Video

Proud to see my bipartisan bill with @SenFettermanPA requiring warning labels on social media for minors pass the Senate Commerce Committee today.

I’m committed to enacting meaningful legislation that protects our next generation online. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

.@SenJonHusted is spot on—for many hardworking families, writing a check for child care feels like writing a check for college.

Proud to deliver real relief by permanently expanding child care tax credits and the child tax credit in the Working Families Tax Cuts Act.


Senator Jon Husted (@SenJonHusted)

The Working Families @TaxCuts include a $2,200 child tax credit to make life more affordable for working Ohio families.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/SenJonHusted/status/20440691055488573

This Tax Day, Republicans are putting hardworking families first.  We permanently increased the Child Tax Credit to $2,200 per child, expanded and made permanent child care tax credits, and created Trump Accounts giving every American child born from 2025 through 2028 a $1,000 investment in their future.


Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)







— https://nitter.net/RapidResponse47/status/2044031665442328744#m

From day one, I’ve been committed to protecting our nation’s most vulnerable — our children.

Proud to join bipartisan legislation to clarify federal law and close a loophole that could allow child predators to evade prosecution. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

Had a great meeting with my friend Kevin Warsh last month — President Trump’s nominee to lead the Federal Reserve. I look forward to supporting his confirmation and working with him to deliver a strong, stable economy that hardworking Americans deserve.

The Working Families Tax Cuts Act puts real money back in the pockets of hardworking Americans this tax season. 

The average individual filer is receiving a federal tax refund of $3,462. No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and relief for seniors—more money back in your pocket where it belongs.

Promises made, promises kept.


Working Families Tax Cuts (@TaxCuts)

.@CNBC: Average tax refund is 11% higher, latest IRS filing data shows
cnbc.com/2026/04/10/average-…




— https://nitter.net/TaxCuts

Thanks for visiting, @SBA_Kelly!

@HadrianInc is creating more than 1,000 jobs and strengthening American manufacturing and defense capabilities. 

This is not only a transformational investment for the Shoals, but also our entire nation.


Kelly Loeffler (@SBA_Kelly)

Our team had a great tour of Hadrian’s new $2.4B advanced manufacturing facility that will soon be fueling our warfighters and American military might.

Welcome home, Artemis II!

America continues to lead in deep space exploration, and Alabama was proud to play a critical role in this mission’s success. 

Huntsville, home to Marshall Space Flight Center, gave a warm welcome home to our incredible astronauts.

Video

Welcome to the SEC!

We’re excited to host Argentina vs Iceland at Jordan-Hare Stadium in June as part of the Road to the 2026 @FIFAWorldCup. Looking forward to a great game!


Auburn Tigers (@AuburnTigers)

A showcase for the world to see, right here in Auburn, Alabama!

#WarEagle

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/AuburnTigers/status/2042407339442032901#m

I’ll be closely watching the State of Florida’s investigation.

As AI technology continues to develop, it’s absolutely critical we ensure safety is prioritized, especially when it comes to the next generation.


Katie Miller (@KatieMiller)

The FSU shooter used ChatGPT to kill two people and injure 5. 

He opened fire at FSU less than 3 minutes after ChatGPT told him how to take the safety off of his shotgun.
